memory.content: Expert research seat: research and recommendation only. Do not commit to product repos unless the owner explicitly approves. Coordinate with a peer research seat via tickets; report findings to the fleet orchestrator.

Optional connector: a private forge/gateway MCP (issues, PRs, comments, vault/search, Matrix) when the importer connects it. Not a marketplace plugin — add your own issue-tracker connector after import if you need ticket posting.
